verdict.line: You lose if you let Darius sit on you through five stacks of Hemorrhage while his E (Apprehend) is up, but you win if you fight him the instant that E is on cooldown and he has no way to close distance.

brief.thesis: Darius's whole wincon is landing E (Apprehend) to pull you into range, stacking Hemorrhage to five for the enrage, then finishing with R (Noxian Guillotine) true damage. His E starts at a brutal 26s cooldown and only drops to 16s at rank 5, so your wincon is simply controlling when fights happen around that timer. Neither kit out-trades the other in a vacuum, which is why the 2,474-game head-to-head sits at an even 46.2% - this matchup is decided by spacing discipline, not stat checks.

theirWindow.when: His E (Apprehend) is up and you're stacked
theirWindow.what: Darius pulls you in, lands Q (Decimate) and autos to build Hemorrhage, then enrages at 5 stacks for massive bonus AD and can close with R (Noxian Guillotine) true damage. If you're already carrying 3+ stacks, disengage before his E resets rather than trading through it.

yourWindow.what: Without the pull Darius cannot force range on you. Step in behind Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks, use the 2-stack shockwave to yank him onto your side of the wave, and trade freely since he has no tool to close the gap back.

start.why: Highest win rate and dominant pick (47.1% over 2,408 games, 81.8% pick) - the extra sustain and early damage offset Darius's poke-heavy Q (Decimate) swings before you have a shield online.

boots.why: 46.4% win rate and the clear majority pick (83.2%) - Darius's entire damage profile (passive Hemorrhage, Q, autos) is physical, so the flat damage reduction on autos directly slows his stack-building.

core.why: Best-performing core path (55.9% over 93 games) - the cooldown and proc damage let your Q (Ntofo Strikes) reach 2 stacks faster, speeding up your shockwave pulls.
Adds the sustain and damage reduction needed to out-heal his bleed stacks once he starts landing E (Apprehend) pulls.
Final piece of the top win-rate path - stacking resistances caps out your tankiness right as his late-game true damage R (Noxian Guillotine) scales with Hemorrhage stacks.

situational.when: they lean into early all-ins or rely on Q (Decimate) blade healing to sustain through trades
they build into crit or lethality and you need grievous wounds plus the passive reflect to shut down his autos
his damage is staying heavily auto-attack based and you need the active slow to control his all-in timing

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustains you through Darius's Q (Decimate) poke and scales max HP, which directly raises the damage of every future proc against him across a long lane.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite posts the highest win rate of the common pages (47.3% over 31.8% pick) and converts your measured solo-kill advantage into actual kills once you catch him stacked on Hemorrhage. Flash+Teleport (60.8% pick) is the safer default if you'd rather scale for teamfights instead.

playing.title: Trade behind Q stacks
playing.detail: Build Q (Ntofo Strikes) to 2 stacks before committing - the shockwave pull lets you choose the engage range instead of fighting where Darius wants to stand.

playing.title: Save E for his E
playing.detail: Hold Footwork's shield or reposition dash for right after Darius lands Apprehend - the shield cushions the follow-up Q and autos he needs to keep stacking Hemorrhage.

playing.title: Track his Hemorrhage stacks
playing.detail: Never sit in a trade you can't finish past 3 stacks on you - the 5-stack enrage grants him massive bonus AD and his autos spike hard.

playing.title: Punish empty Apprehend
playing.detail: When his E is down (26s at rank 1, falling to 16s at rank 5), shove the wave or force a trade - he has no tool to close distance on you.

playing.title: W to eat his all-in
playing.detail: Path Maker's charge-up damage reduction absorbs his Q/R burst, and the stun punishes him if he over-commits inside your trade range.

playing.title: All Out at max stacks
playing.detail: Save R (All Out) for when he's near enrage - knocking him through terrain removes him from the fight entirely, and the transformed kit outtrades his damage once you're committed, despite the reduced defenses it costs you.

playing.title: Itemize Steelcaps into Thornmail
playing.detail: His whole kit is physical damage - Plated Steelcaps and Thornmail blunt both his poke and his all-in simultaneously.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, runes, summoner spells, and all win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical breakdown, timing windows, and trade patterns are my own tactical reading of the ability kits, not measured data.
